algorithm_asset_requests_binding.name: algorithm_asset_requests_binding
algorithm_asset_requests_binding.value: "algorithm_asset_requests"."status" <> 'bound' OR ("algorithm_asset_requests"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "algorithm_asset_requests"."state" IS NOT NULL)

algorithm_decisions_target.name: algorithm_decisions_target
algorithm_decisions_target.value: ("algorithm_decisions"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("algorithm_decisions"."output_id" IS NOT NULL)

asset_variants_size_positive.name: asset_variants_size_positive
asset_variants_size_positive.value: ("asset_variants"."width" IS NULL OR "asset_variants"."width" > 0) AND ("asset_variants"."height" IS NULL OR "asset_variants"."height" > 0)

playbook_lesson_sources_target.name: playbook_lesson_sources_target
playbook_lesson_sources_target.value: "playbook_lesson_sources"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL OR "playbook_lesson_sources"."decision_id" IS NOT NULL

videos_kind_status.name: videos_kind_status
videos_kind_status.value: ("videos"."kind" = 'cartoon' AND "videos"."status" IS NOT NULL) OR ("videos"."kind" = 'algorithm' AND "videos"."status" IS NULL)
